"""Weekly activity report."""

from datetime import date, timedelta


def build_report(events, today):
    start = today - timedelta(days=7)
    recent = [event for event in events if start < event["day"] <= today]
    by_user = {}
    for event in recent:
        by_user[event["user"]] = by_user.get(event["user"], 0) + 1
    ranking = sorted(by_user.items(), key=lambda pair: (-pair[1], pair[0]))
    lines = [f"weekly report for {today.isoformat()}"]
    lines.append(f"{len(recent)} events from {len(by_user)} users")
    for user, count in ranking[:3]:
        lines.append(f"  {user}: {count}")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def main(events):
    print(build_report(events, date(2026, 11, 14)))
